title: Public Alert No. 04/2026- Nestle UK RecallsSpecific Batches Of Its SMAInfant Formula and Follow-On FormulaOver Toxin Contamination Concerns
summary: Nestlé UK voluntarily recalled certain batches of SMA Infant Formula and Follow-On Formula over possible cereulide toxin contamination. NAFDAC says the recall does not affect SMA formulae produced for Nigeria, and lists registered SMA Gold 1, 2 and 3 NAFDAC numbers.
